body: Is it possible to run [this step](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#url-and-history-update-steps:~:text=Update%20the%20navigation%20API%20entries%20for%20a%20same%2Ddocument%20navigation%20given%20document%27s%20relevant%20global%20object%27s%20navigation%20API%2C%20newEntry%2C%20and%20historyHandling%2E) in "URL and history update steps", by having them appended to the session history queue, just like step [13 does with finalize](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#url-and-history-update-steps:~:text=Append%20the%20following%20session%20history%20synchronous%20navigation%20steps%20involving%20navigable%20to%20traversable%3A,-Finalize%20a%20same%2Ddocument%20navigation%20given%20traversable%2C%20navigable%2C%20newEntry)?
Yeah, I think we need some clarification around what Chrome does for this not to happen.

I think I found where chrome handles this, see [DispatchNavigateEvent](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:third_party/blink/renderer/core/navigation_api/navigation_api.cc;l=786-794?q=!keys_to_indices_.&ss=chromium%2Fchromium%2Fsrc)

Also, it may be the case that this is not a race condition, because [12.2 and 12.3](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#performing-a-navigation-api-traversal) checks Session History entries, when what has happened is that a navigation history entry that "wrapped" a session history entry, has been removed. So "there's a dependency between NHE and SHE that's gone out of sync", is probably a better description.

A later check in [inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#inner-navigate-event-firing-algorithm:~:text=If%20destination%27s%20entry%20is%20non%2Dnull) I think can be done where we do "if null, reject promises and abort"; could potentially be the fix that solves this, because it is a check on the event loop, so NHE mutation can't interleave or happen beyond that point.

But it's tricky.
